# Source: Teapot with Symbols of England, Ireland, and Scotland

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Teapot with Symbols of England, Ireland, and Scotland
- **Artist / culture:** Staffordshire, England
- **Date:** c. 1830
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** teapot
- **Department:** Applied Arts of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 5407
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/5407
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/05207941-1c7b-5ba3-c49c-1555d03e1247/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Symbolism

## Extracted source palette

`#686868, #888888, #A8A8A8, #484848, #D8D8C8, #F8F8E8, #C8B8A8, #785828`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#252525`
- `surface`: `#3E3E3E`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#785828`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#F8F8E8`
- `surface_variant`: `#3E3E3E`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#606060`
- `error`: `#785828`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `14.42:1`, surface `10.06:1`
- Variant contrast: `10.06:1`
- Control contrast: `6.12:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
